name: Ram Kumar N
abt_description:
I'm Ram Kumar N — Backend Lead and Full Stack Developer at Pupa Clic, Chennai. I've grown the Aaiwa service platform from 30,000 to 40,000+ active users, cut API response times by ~40%, and maintained a React Native app at 99.5% crash-free for 12+ months across iOS and Android.

My stack spans the full picture: Node.js, Laravel, MERN, React Native, Expo, TypeScript, and 10+ third-party integrations including Stripe, Firebase, Razorpay, and OneSignal. I've shipped apps in healthcare, government, e-commerce, multimedia, and SaaS — independently and as a team lead.

B.Sc. Computer Science Gold Medalist. Meta Certified Front-End Developer. Open to remote worldwide.
abt_title: 3+ years of shipping products people actually use.
